continuity_scope: Fate/stay night REMASTERED, Fate (Saber Route) official route-introduction and REMASTERED character profiles. The selected 2024 Steam/Nintendo Switch title is an HD, 16:9 remaster based on the 2012 PS Vita Fate/stay night [Réalta Nua], with Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese support. This is an opening-premise pass for the Fate/Saber route only—not Unlimited Blade Works, Heaven's Feel, another visual-novel version, or a merged Fate franchise canon.
work_or_witnesses: Fate/stay night REMASTERED, Fate (Saber Route) official TYPE-MOON introduction
Fate/stay night REMASTERED official TYPE-MOON profiles for Shirou Emiya and Saber
Fate/stay night REMASTERED official Aniplex product page
coverage_rule: Include only named individual dramatic characters directly named in the selected Fate/Saber-route introduction or the selected REMASTERED profiles and material to the stated route premise: Shirou Emiya, Saber, and Kiritsugu Emiya. Directly stated rescue and Master/Servant contract relationships are included. All other profile characters, unnamed Masters/Servants, class labels, the Holy Grail, Root, Fuyuki, mechanics, artifacts, and historic/mythic reference possibilities remain dimensions/terms or omissions rather than character nodes.
omissions: Unlimited Blade Works (Rin Tohsaka Route) and Heaven's Feel (Sakura Matou Route) are explicitly separate route pages and are not merged into this Fate/Saber-route pass.

The original 2004 visual novel, 2012 PS Vita edition, other ports/localizations, anime, films, manga, games, novels, guidebooks, Fate/Grand Order, Fate/Zero, other Fate timelines, and all adaptations/spin-offs are separate witnesses.

All other named REMASTERED-profile individuals are omitted unless the selected Fate-route introduction itself materially identifies them for this premise; their profile availability does not merge their route-specific narratives here.

Servant classes, Heroic Spirits, Masters, magecraft, Noble Phantasms, Holy Grail systems, places, mechanics, and historical/mythic source figures remain terms/dimensions. No class, Grail, artifact, place, or source-person is made a relationship endpoint.

The selected synopsis establishes ritual competition, attacks, rescue, and IARC 16+ rating, but it does not license an exhaustive account of violence, injury, death, sexual content, abuse, route outcomes, or wider-franchise lore.
uncertainties: The selected Fate-route introduction is Japanese source text on the official TYPE-MOON site; the REMASTERED product officially supports English, but this pass does not claim the Japanese prose is identical to its English localization wording.

Saber is an individual character name/profile and a Servant class label in the selected materials. This pass records the named REMASTERED Fate-route individual as Saber but does not infer a historical/mythic identity, alternative summon incarnation, Noble Phantasm, or cross-route equivalence.

The route introduction calls Shirou a Master saved by a sword Heroic Spirit and the Saber profile calls her one of seven Servants contracted with the protagonist. It supports their Fate-route contract/premise, not all later relationship developments or endings.

Kiritsugu is named in a past rescue and household/magecraft-learning account. The official Fate-route introduction does not call him biological or adoptive parent, does not supply a complete teaching record, and does not authorize details from other Fate works.

The Grail War is fictionalized fantasy ritual/magecraft. Historic and mythic names/concepts that occur elsewhere in Fate media are neither authenticated nor equated with living or historical traditions in this narrow pass.
evidence_basis: TYPE-MOON and Aniplex first-party REMASTERED route, character-profile, and product pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, anime synopsis, game database, novel, guidebook, uninspected visual-novel text capture, or external historical/mythic source is used as character evidence.
